description_en: Lists the databases that a user group is authorized to manage through a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 查询用户组已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases-for-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2ve7h00a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabasesForUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user group for which you want to query authorized databases
parameters.help_zh: 要查询已授权数据库的用户组ID
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. By default, 20 entries are returned on each page. If you leave the PageSize parameter empty, 20 entries are returned. We recommend that you do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据库实例名称
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the database that you want to query. Only term query is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_address

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database that you want to query. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain
parameters.name: network_domain_id

Databases.description_en: The list of databases that are queried

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The type of the database address. Valid values:

Public: public address

Private: private address
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
数据库地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

Comment.description_en: The description of the database instance
Comment.description_zh: 数据库实例的备注信息

DatabaseAccountCount.description_en: The total number of database accounts that are queried
DatabaseAccountCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户总数量

DatabaseId.description_en: The ID of the database instance to which the database account belongs
DatabaseId.description_zh: 数据库账号所属数据库实例ID

DatabaseName.description_en: The name of the database instance

DatabasePrivateAddress.description_en: The private endpoint of the database, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePrivateAddress.description_zh: 数据库的私网地址，可为域名或ip地址

DatabasePublicAddress.description_en: The public address of the database, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePublicAddress.description_zh: 数据库的公网地址，可为域名或ip地址

DatabaseType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MySQL

Oracle

PostgreSQL

SQLServer
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the database belongs
NetworkDomainId.description_zh: 数据库所属的网络域的ID

Source.description_en:
The source of the database. Valid values:

Local: local database instance

Rds: RDS database instance

PolarDB: PolarDB database instance
Source.description_zh:
数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the RDS instance or PolarDB instance that corresponds to the database.

If Source is set to Local, this parameter is empty
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
数据库对应的RDS实例ID或PolarDB实例ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of databases that are queried
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库总数量
